mapper.insert: insert into review (user_id, target_id, target_type, review_content) values ( #{userId}, #{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{reviewContent})

insert into review (user_id, review_title, review_content, review_count, review_date, review_modify, target_id, target_type) values ( #{userId}, #{reviewTitle}, #{reviewContent}, #{reviewCount}, #{reviewDate}, #{reviewModify}, #{targetId}, #{targetType})
mapper.select: select review_id AS reviewId, review_date AS reviewDate, review_modify AS reviewModify, is_deleted AS isDeleted from review where review_id = #{reviewId}

select review_id AS reviewId, review_title AS reviewTitle, review_content AS reviewContent, review_count AS reviewCount, review_date AS reviewDate, review_modify AS reviewModify, target_id AS targetId, target_type AS targetType, is_deleted AS isDeleted from review where review_id = #{reviewId}
